provenance.note: POST /api/show answers, reduced to the fields EYAS reads (capabilities, thinking). The capability names are Ollama's own constants; the gpt-oss thinking object is the documented example; the qwen3 on/off values follow the documented boolean form ('values can contain booleans for on/off controls'); the '@legacy-server' entries are servers that report the 'thinking' capability without a thinking object. Transcribed from the sources, not captured from a live server (no Ollama server was running on the dev host); replace with a live capture (free: /api/show loads no weights) when one is taken.
sources: https://github.com/ollama/ollama/blob/main/types/model/capability.go (completion, tools, insert, vision, embedding, thinking, image, audio)
https://docs.ollama.com/capabilities/thinking (/api/show thinking: { values: [low, medium, high], default: medium } for gpt-oss; booleans for on/off controls)
https://github.com/ollama/ollama/blob/main/server/routes.go (a truthy think on a model without the thinking capability is rejected with HTTP 400)
